meta.name: brainstorm-experiments-existing
meta.description: Design experiments to test assumptions for an existing product — prototypes, A/B tests, spikes, and other low-effort validation methods. Use when validating assumptions, testing feature ideas cheaply, or planning product experiments.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计低成本实验验证产品假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为现有产品设计验证实验
copy.tagline_en: Design low-cost experiments to validate product assumptions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing validation experiments for an existing product

howto.what: 当用户描述一个现有产品的功能想法和假设时，Claude 会设计低成本的实验来验证这些假设，例如原型测试、A/B 测试、技术探针等，并给出每个实验的假设、具体做法、衡量指标和成功标准。
howto.when: 当用户需要验证现有产品的某个功能假设，或想低成本测试新想法时触发。用户需提供想法和假设，也可附上 PRD 或假设列表等文件。

say.text: 我们想给购物车加一个“稍后购买”按钮，怎么验证这个想法？
say.note: Claude 会设计实验来测试该功能假设。

say.text: 假设用户会因为推荐算法更精准而增加购买，设计一个低成本实验。
say.note: Claude 会给出实验方案，包括指标和成功标准。

howto.what_en: When you describe a feature idea and assumptions for an existing product, Claude designs low-effort experiments (prototypes, A/B tests, spikes, etc.) to validate them, specifying the assumption, experiment, metric, and success threshold for each.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to validate assumptions for an existing product feature or test ideas cheaply. Provide the idea and assumptions; optionally attach PRDs or assumption lists.

say_en.text: We want to add a 'Save for Later' button to the cart. How can we test this idea?
say_en.note: Claude will design experiments to validate the feature assumption.

say_en.text: Assume users will buy more if recommendations are more accurate. Design a low-cost experiment.
say_en.note: Claude will propose an experiment with metrics and success criteria.
